objective:
Implement the three domain services that sit between the interpreter/validator and the ActivityRepository: the capture interpretation orchestrator, the correction service and review resolution. Pure Kotlin in core-domain, an in-memory ActivityRepository fake in core-testing, and one end-to-end integration test on real Room in core-data.

CONTEXT (all exists; read the actual source for exact names — do not change existing signatures except the additive enum constants allowed below)
core-domain packages under com.mcfrenchpants.activityledger.core.domain:
- interpretation: InterpretationCandidate(operation, activityResolution, matchedActivityId?, proposedCanonicalName?, activityState?, temporalExpression?, confidenceBand?); CandidateActivity(id, displayName, aliases); InterpretationInput(rawText, capturedAt, zoneId, candidates); InterpreterProvenance(interpreterVersion, promptVersion, schemaVersion); enum InterpreterFailureKind {UNAVAILABLE, RETRYABLE, MALFORMED, OTHER}; sealed InterpretationResult { Success(candidate, structuredResultJson?); Failure(kind, structuredResultJson?) }; interface ActivityInterpreter { val provenance; suspend fun interpret(input) }; InterpretationRecord(createdAt, interpreterVersion, promptVersion, schemaVersion, operation, activityResolution, matchedActivityId?, proposedCanonicalName?, activityState?, temporalExpression?, resolvedOccurredAt?, timePrecision?, modelConfidenceBand?, candidateContextHash?, structuredResultJson?, validationStatus, validationReason?).
- repository: interface ActivityRepository (suspend createRawCapture, getCapture, loadCatalog, recordOutcome(captureId, interpretation?, processingState), acceptInterpretation(captureId, interpretation, target, occurredAt, timePrecision, activityState): String, applyCorrection(occurrenceId, changes, source, reason?, now): CorrectionOutcome, getOccurrence, getActivity). READ ITS KDOC: it is the error contract the fake must honour (IllegalArgumentException + nothing written for unknown capture/occurrence, missing or non-ACTIVE target activity, recordOutcome on a capture with an occurrence or with a state other than NEEDS_REVIEW/FAILED_RETRYABLE/FAILED_FINAL; accept is idempotent per capture returning the existing occurrence id; applyCorrection returns NothingChanged when nothing differs; read functions return null for unknown ids; the repository normalizes names itself). Types in RepositoryTypes.kt: CatalogActivity, StoredCapture(…, hasOccurrence), OccurrenceView(…, visibilityStatus), ActivityView(id, displayName, normalizedName, status), NewRawCapture, sealed ActivityTarget {Existing(activityId); New(displayName)}, CorrectionChanges(activity?, occurredAt?, timePrecision?, activityState?), sealed CorrectionOutcome {Applied(correctionId); NothingChanged}.
- candidates: CandidateSelector(bound = 40).select(catalog, rawText): CandidateSelection(candidates, contextHash).
- temporal: TemporalResolver().resolve(expression?, capturedAt, zoneId): TemporalResolution (Resolved(occurredAt, precision) | Future | Unresolvable).
- validation: InterpretationValidator().validate(ValidationInput(candidate, suppliedCandidates, catalog, temporal, speechConfidence)): ValidationDecision(outcome: ValidationOutcome {AUTO_ACCEPT, NEEDS_REVIEW, REJECT}, validationStatus, reasons: Set<ValidationReason>, reasonCodes: String?). ValidationReason constant NAMES are persisted text.
- naming: NameNormalizer.normalize(text); NewActivityNameCheck.check(name): Result {Ok | Invalid(reason: NewActivityNameCheck.Reason)}.
- model enums: ProcessingState {CAPTURED, QUEUED_FOR_PHONE, TRANSCRIBED, INTERPRETING, INTERPRETED, PERSISTED, NEEDS_REVIEW, FAILED_RETRYABLE, FAILED_FINAL}; CorrectionSource {USER, REINTERPRETATION}; ActivityState {COMPLETED, IN_PROGRESS}; TimePrecision {EXACT, APPROXIMATE, DATE_ONLY, INFERRED_NOW}; VisibilityStatus {ACTIVE, HIDDEN}; CanonicalActivityStatus {ACTIVE, MERGED, ARCHIVED}; InterpretationOperation {LOG_ACTIVITY, QUERY_HISTORY, UNSUPPORTED}; ActivityResolution {EXISTING_ACTIVITY, NEW_ACTIVITY, AMBIGUOUS, UNRESOLVED}.
core-testing (pure JVM, api(core-domain), api(kotlin("test"))): MutableClock(instant, zone), FakeActivityInterpreter (enqueue/respondWith, callCount, receivedInputs), runSuspend { } (fails if the block really suspends).
core-data (Android library): public fun createActivityRepository(context, clock); internal RoomActivityRepository(database, idFactory, clock, dispatcher); tests are Robolectric (@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class), sdk 35) and use inMemoryTestDatabase<ActivityLedgerDatabase>(), DeterministicIdFactory, runBlocking, fixture SQL helpers in core-data/src/test (see RoomActivityRepositoryTest for the pattern). core-data does NOT yet depend on core-testing.

DESIGN (these technical decisions are made; implement them)
New package com.mcfrenchpants.activityledger.core.domain.services (public types, KDoc on each; no logging; exception/refusal content is ids and enum names only).

1. Shared time choice: data class OccurrenceTime(val occurredAt: Instant, val precision: TimePrecision).

2. CaptureInterpretationOrchestrator(repository: ActivityRepository, interpreter: ActivityInterpreter, clock: Clock, selector: CandidateSelector = CandidateSelector(), resolver: TemporalResolver = TemporalResolver(), validator: InterpretationValidator = InterpretationValidator()).
   suspend fun process(captureId: String): CaptureProcessingOutcome, sealed:
   - AutoAccepted(occurrenceId: String)
   - NeedsReview(reasons: Set<ValidationReason>)   // validator NEEDS_REVIEW
   - Rejected(reasons: Set<ValidationReason>)      // validator REJECT, or MALFORMED/OTHER interpreter failure
   - InterpreterUnavailable(kind: InterpreterFailureKind)  // UNAVAILABLE or RETRYABLE
   - AlreadyHasOccurrence                          // no interpreter call, no writes
   Steps: getCapture (null -> IllegalArgumentException "unknown capture <id>"); if hasOccurrence -> AlreadyHasOccurrence (no other repository call, interpreter not called). Any other processing state is (re)processable. loadCatalog; selector.select(catalog, rawText); interpreter.interpret(InterpretationInput(rawText, capturedAt, zoneId, selection.candidates)).
   - Failure UNAVAILABLE/RETRYABLE -> recordOutcome(captureId, null, FAILED_RETRYABLE) -> InterpreterUnavailable(kind).
   - Failure MALFORMED/OTHER -> recordOutcome(captureId, record, NEEDS_REVIEW) where record: createdAt = clock.instant(), provenance from interpreter.provenance, operation UNSUPPORTED, activityResolution UNRESOLVED, all nullable model fields null, candidateContextHash = selection.contextHash, structuredResultJson = failure's json, validationStatus INVALID, validationReason = the new reason code name -> Rejected(setOf(reason)). Add two constants to ValidationReason (additive; place them with the rejecting reasons): INTERPRETER_OUTPUT_MALFORMED(true) for MALFORMED, INTERPRETER_FAILED(true) for OTHER. The validator itself never emits them; add a KDoc line saying so.
   - Success -> temporal = resolver.resolve(candidate.temporalExpression, capturedAt, zoneId); decision = validator.validate(ValidationInput(candidate, selection.candidates, catalog, temporal, capture.speechConfidence)). Record = createdAt clock.instant(), provenance, candidate fields copied verbatim (operation, resolution, matchedActivityId, proposedCanonicalName, activityState, temporalExpression, confidenceBand as modelConfidenceBand), resolvedOccurredAt/timePrecision from Resolved else null, candidateContextHash, structuredResultJson, validationStatus = decision.validationStatus, validationReason = decision.reasonCodes.
     AUTO_ACCEPT -> acceptInterpretation(captureId, record, target = Existing(matchedActivityId) for EXISTING_ACTIVITY or New(proposedCanonicalName) for NEW_ACTIVITY, occurredAt/precision from Resolved, activityState = candidate.activityState) -> AutoAccepted(id). (The validator guarantees these are non-null on AUTO_ACCEPT; use checkNotNull with an id-only message rather than !!.) If the repository throws IllegalArgumentException (e.g. the chosen activity was archived between catalog load and accept) let it propagate: nothing was written and a rerun re-reads the catalog.
     NEEDS_REVIEW -> recordOutcome(captureId, record, NEEDS_REVIEW) -> NeedsReview(reasons).
     REJECT -> recordOutcome(captureId, record, NEEDS_REVIEW) -> Rejected(reasons).
   An exception thrown by the interpreter itself propagates (the interface asks implementations not to throw; do not swallow it). No clock reads other than record createdAt.

3. CorrectionService(repository: ActivityRepository, clock: Clock).
   data class CorrectionRequest(val activity: ActivityTarget? = null, val time: OccurrenceTime? = null, val activityState: ActivityState? = null)
   suspend fun correct(occurrenceId: String, request: CorrectionRequest, reason: String? = null): CorrectionResult, sealed:
   - Applied(correctionId), NothingChanged, Refused(refusal: ServiceRefusal)
   now = clock.instant() read once. Checks in this order, each returning Refused without writing: getOccurrence null -> OCCURRENCE_NOT_FOUND; visibility HIDDEN -> OCCURRENCE_HIDDEN; activity Existing: getActivity null -> ACTIVITY_NOT_FOUND, status != ACTIVE -> ACTIVITY_NOT_ACTIVE; activity New: name check (see 5); time.occurredAt after now -> OCCURRED_AFTER_NOW. Then repository.applyCorrection(occurrenceId, CorrectionChanges(activity, time?.occurredAt, time?.precision, activityState), CorrectionSource.USER, reason, now) mapped to Applied/NothingChanged. An Existing target equal to the occurrence's current activity is simply passed through (the repository reports NothingChanged if nothing else differs).

4. ReviewResolutionService(repository: ActivityRepository, clock: Clock).
   suspend fun resolve(captureId: String, activity: ActivityTarget, time: OccurrenceTime? = null, activityState: ActivityState = ActivityState.COMPLETED): ResolutionResult, sealed: Resolved(occurrenceId) | Refused(refusal: ServiceRefusal).
   now = clock.instant() once. getCapture null -> CAPTURE_NOT_FOUND; hasOccurrence -> CAPTURE_ALREADY_HAS_OCCURRENCE (never returns the existing id as success — the user is resolving something already resolved); activity checks as in 3 (Existing: not found / not ACTIVE; New: name check); chosen = time ?: OccurrenceTime(capture.capturedAt, INFERRED_NOW); chosen.occurredAt after now -> OCCURRED_AFTER_NOW. Build a fresh user-resolution InterpretationRecord (spec §5.3): createdAt now, interpreterVersion = USER_RESOLUTION_INTERPRETER_VERSION = "user-resolution", promptVersion = "none", schemaVersion = USER_RESOLUTION_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1 (public consts in the services package), operation LOG_ACTIVITY, resolution EXISTING_ACTIVITY with matchedActivityId = id and proposedCanonicalName null, or NEW_ACTIVITY with matchedActivityId null and proposedCanonicalName = displayName.trim(); activityState; temporalExpression null; resolvedOccurredAt/timePrecision = chosen; modelConfidenceBand, candidateContextHash, structuredResultJson null; validationStatus VALID; validationReason null. Then acceptInterpretation(captureId, record, target (New with the trimmed name), chosen.occurredAt, chosen.precision, activityState) -> Resolved(id). Earlier interpretations of the capture are never touched.

5. Refusals and the user-typed new name: sealed interface ServiceRefusal (or an enum plus data classes — your call, keep it exhaustive-when friendly) with: OCCURRENCE_NOT_FOUND, OCCURRENCE_HIDDEN, CAPTURE_NOT_FOUND, CAPTURE_ALREADY_HAS_OCCURRENCE, ACTIVITY_NOT_FOUND, ACTIVITY_NOT_ACTIVE, OCCURRED_AFTER_NOW, InvalidName(reason: NewActivityNameCheck.Reason), NameMatchesExistingActivity(activityId: String). For ActivityTarget.New in both services: NewActivityNameCheck.check(displayName) Invalid -> InvalidName(reason); else if NameNormalizer.normalize(displayName) equals the normalizedName or any normalizedAliases entry of an entry in repository.loadCatalog() -> NameMatchesExistingActivity(that entry's id) so the UI can offer the existing activity instead of creating a duplicate. Put this shared check in one internal function.

6. core-testing: InMemoryActivityRepository(clock: Clock) : ActivityRepository, deterministic ids (e.g. "capture-1", "interpretation-1", "activity-1", "occurrence-1", "correction-1"), honouring the ActivityRepository KDoc error contract exactly (IllegalArgumentException and nothing written; atomic: validate everything before mutating). Names normalized with NameNormalizer. loadCatalog: ACTIVE activities only, aliases normalized, lastOccurredAt = max occurredAt of ACTIVE-visibility occurrences, ordered by normalized name then id. Test-seeding and inspection helpers (not part of the interface): seedActivity(displayName, status = ACTIVE, aliases = emptyList()): String; setVisibility(occurrenceId, VisibilityStatus); interpretationsFor(captureId): List<InterpretationRecord> (in insertion order); corrections: List of a small public data class describing each correction (occurrence id, previous/new values, source, reason, createdAt); writeCount: Int incremented by every successful mutating call (so tests can assert "no writes"). Its own test class in core-testing proves each contract rule (unknown ids, non-ACTIVE target, disallowed recordOutcome states, recordOutcome after occurrence, accept idempotency, NothingChanged, catalog filtering and hidden-occurrence exclusion, raw text unchanged after every write).

7. core-data integration test: add testImplementation(project(":core-testing")) to core-data/build.gradle.kts (check the build still resolves; if Gradle refuses the JVM-module-into-Android-test dependency, report scope_change_requested rather than working around it). New Robolectric test (e.g. core-data/src/test/.../repository/OrchestratorIntegrationTest.kt) using RoomActivityRepository on an in-memory DB, a MutableClock at 2026-09-15T20:00-04:00 zone America/Detroit, and FakeActivityInterpreter. Seed an ACTIVE activity "Mow lawn" (via fixture SQL or by accepting an earlier synthetic capture — your call). createRawCapture("I cut the grass yesterday.", capturedAt = that instant, zone America/Detroit, speechConfidence null, state CAPTURED); fake returns Success(LOG_ACTIVITY, EXISTING_ACTIVITY, matched = Mow lawn id, state COMPLETED, temporalExpression "yesterday", HIGH). Assert AutoAccepted; occurrence activity = Mow lawn, occurredAt = 2026-09-14T00:00 America/Detroit (2026-09-14T04:00:00Z), DATE_ONLY; capture PERSISTED; raw_text byte-identical; processing again -> AlreadyHasOccurrence with interpreter callCount unchanged. Add one more case in the same class: a review resolution on real Room for a capture recorded NEEDS_REVIEW by the orchestrator (fake returns AMBIGUOUS) resolved to a New activity -> occurrence exists, capture has two interpretations, the earlier one unchanged, the new one "user-resolution".
non_goals: No change to core-data/src/main, core-data/schemas, or the database version. No new data-layer operation.
No change to any existing core-domain signature; the only edit to existing core-domain main code is the two additive ValidationReason constants (plus their KDoc).
No hide/restore, alias writes, merges, re-interpretation of accepted captures, listing of review captures, query interpretation, or app-phone wiring.
No new libraries (no kotlinx-coroutines in core-domain or core-testing, no coroutines-test); core-data tests may use runBlocking which is already available there.
No logging. Do not @Ignore, disable or weaken any test. Do not commit. Do not edit docs, tracking files, .sdlc or scripts.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator tests in core-domain (InMemoryActivityRepository + FakeActivityInterpreter + MutableClock, driven with runSuspend): AUTO_ACCEPT EXISTING and AUTO_ACCEPT NEW each create exactly one occurrence with the resolved time/precision and state, capture PERSISTED, NEW creates an ACTIVE activity; NEEDS_REVIEW (e.g. MEDIUM confidence, and the 'I edged the lawn.' EXISTING Mow lawn LOW case) stores one interpretation with validationStatus NEEDS_REVIEW and reason codes, capture NEEDS_REVIEW, no occurrence and no new activity; REJECT (e.g. EXISTING with an id not in the shortlist, and QUERY_HISTORY) stores one INVALID interpretation, capture NEEDS_REVIEW, no occurrence; MALFORMED and OTHER failures store one INVALID interpretation carrying the interpreter provenance, the structured JSON, the context hash and reason INTERPRETER_OUTPUT_MALFORMED / INTERPRETER_FAILED, capture NEEDS_REVIEW; UNAVAILABLE and RETRYABLE store no interpretation and set FAILED_RETRYABLE; rerun on a capture with an occurrence returns AlreadyHasOccurrence with interpreter callCount and repository writeCount unchanged; unknown capture id throws IllegalArgumentException; a NEEDS_REVIEW capture can be processed again (appends a second interpretation).

Orchestrator passes the interpreter exactly the selector's shortlist and the capture's raw text, instant and zone (asserted via receivedInputs), and every stored record's candidateContextHash equals the selection hash.

Correction service tests: refuses unknown occurrence, HIDDEN occurrence, missing target activity, ARCHIVED and MERGED target activity, occurred time after now (1 ms after is refused, exactly now is allowed), an invalid new name (InvalidName with the check's reason), a new name matching an existing activity's name or alias (NameMatchesExistingActivity with its id) — each with repository writeCount unchanged; a request equal to current values returns NothingChanged; a time change stores the given precision; activity change to Existing and to New both apply with source USER and the reason text passed through; now comes from the clock.

Review resolution tests: existing and new activity; default time = capture instant with INFERRED_NOW; an explicit time override stored with its precision; refuses unknown capture, capture that already has an occurrence, non-ACTIVE/missing activity, invalid or duplicate new name, time after now — no writes on refusal; the stored interpretation has interpreterVersion 'user-resolution', promptVersion 'none', VALID, matched id / proposed name agreeing with the target; any earlier interpretation of the capture is unchanged; works for a FAILED_RETRYABLE capture with no interpretation at all.
InMemoryActivityRepository has its own contract test class in core-testing covering every rule listed in design item 6.

ValidationReason gains exactly INTERPRETER_OUTPUT_MALFORMED and INTERPRETER_FAILED (both rejects = true); no existing constant renamed, reordered semantics unchanged; existing InterpretationValidatorTest passes (adjust it only if it enumerates the full constant list, and report that).

core-data integration test (Robolectric, real in-memory Room) passes both scenarios in design item 7, including occurredAt == 2026-09-14T04:00:00Z with DATE_ONLY, capture PERSISTED, raw text byte-identical and AlreadyHasOccurrence on rerun.

core-domain main still has no imports outside kotlin.*, java.* and its own packages (report a grep); no Instant.now/System.currentTimeMillis/ZoneId.systemDefault in core-domain main or core-testing main; no logging/println added.
core-data/schemas unchanged (git diff empty); no core-data/src/main change.
`./gradlew test --rerun-tasks` passes; report per-class JUnit XML test counts for every new or changed test class.
